subject: Mutual plan: fast-track POC wiring and credentials
body:
From: Kevin Zhou <kevin.zhou@elliot-labs.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@elliot-labs.com
Date: 2026-09-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual plan: fast-track POC wiring and credentials

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick demo today — Elliot Labs is excited to run a short, production-ish POC to validate inference latency and cost at our payload sizes. We want to fast-track the MAP so we can get ingesting calls by next week.

High level asks we want to align on:
- Org and tenant creation (so we can invite our service account)
- API keys / ephemeral test tokens with limited quota for ingest testing
- IP allowlist entry for our test runners (CIDRs below)
- VPC peering for the dedicated test pool (we can accept a template)

I attached the MAP-checklist with our internal milestones. Are you able to confirm owners and target dates for each?

Kevin
VP Platform, Elliot Labs

Attachments: MAP-checklist-elliot.xlsx (spreadsheet)

----- Original message -----

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Kevin Zhou <kevin.zhou@elliot-labs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan: fast-track POC wiring and credentials

Kevin — great to hear — and thanks for laying this out. We can absolutely fast-track. Below is a proposed MAP with owners and a two-week close runway.

Proposed mutual action plan (owners / target dates):
1) Org + tenant setup
   - Owner: Neha (Redwood Solutions) / Ops contact (Elliot Labs)
   - Target: 2026-09-04 (tomorrow) — Redwood creates tenant and invites service account; Elliot confirms membership.

2) API keys & ephemeral test tokens
   - Owner: Marissa (CS) for provisioning; Ben (Infra) for ephemeral generator
   - Target: 2026-09-06 — deliver permanent API key for staging and ephemeral test-token generator script.
   - Note: we'll provide scoped keys (read-only vs inference) and quotas.

3) IP allowlist
   - Owner: Ben (Infra) to submit allowlist on our side; Elliot to confirm CIDR(s).
   - Target: 2026-09-05 — allowlist entry and smoke test to confirm reachability.

4) VPC peering (dedicated test pool)
   - Owner: Ben (Redwood infra) + Elliot peering owner
   - Target: 2026-09-08 — finish peering handshake and routing setup; we will provide sample route and template (see vpc-peering-template.txt).

5) Acceptance criteria / smoke tests
   - Owner: Elliot (runs tests) + Redwood (observability on tokens)
   - Target: 2026-09-09 — latency check and tokenized cost estimate delivered.

A few quick asks from our side:
- Please confirm the CIDR(s) you plan to originate for the peering and the IPs for allowlist.
- Who on your side will own the Terraform/peering request? We will fill in the template but want an on-call owner.

I attached two small stubs: vpc-peering-template.txt and ephemeral-test-keys.txt (a reference script for ephemeral tokens).

If that timeline works we can lock these dates and schedule a 15-minute standup tomorrow to unblock org creation.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Neha Kapoor
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: vpc-peering-template.txt, ephemeral-test-keys.txt

----- Reply (from Marissa) -----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Kevin Zhou <kevin.zhou@elliot-labs.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan: fast-track POC wiring and credentials

This plan looks good — I'll provision the scoped staging API key and the ephemeral token endpoint. A couple of operational details: 
- I'll create the staging API key with a 24-hour rotation reminder and attach it to the MAP checklist.
- I'll need the service account email you want invited to the tenant (kevin, please share) and confirm SSO vs invite.
- For sanity checks, we'll hand over a small sample prompt set (100 requests) for you to run through the peering link once established.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood

----- Reply (from Ben) -----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Kevin Zhou <kevin.zhou@elliot-labs.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan: fast-track POC wiring and credentials

Kevin / Neha — quick infra update.
- We attempted to validate the CIDR you sent (10.42.0.0/16) against our peering pool; that range is fine but please confirm whether NAT is needed for your runners.
- Action for Elliot: please share the peering owner (name + email) so we can exchange peering requests and set routing.
- I will open the allowlist entry today for the following test IPs you provided: 34.82.11.7, 34.82.11.8. Expect propagation within an hour.

One note on credentials: ephemeral-test-keys.txt contains a sample script that issues short-lived tokens tied to a user id. We will only enable ephemeral issuance for the test tenant after the peering and allowlist smoke test passes.

Ben Carter
Infrastructure, Redwood Inference

----- End of thread -----
